speaker: james_burbage
text: I could build you a heavens for five pound, if I had five pound and a lease.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You have the house. You do not have five pound spare for a chair, and the lease is not a purse.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Then I have a knife and a crust, and Henslowe has the chair. That is the difference between the two houses this Wednesday.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Lower Kemp. If a man must come down, let it be the man the yard is already glad to see before his feet have left the ground.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Why can you not winch me down on a barrel? A barrel is honest timber. A throne is a carpenter telling the truth about money.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A boy and two men with clean verse can build a castle out of air, and it costs nothing to strike.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Air does not jam. Air also does not take seven pounds and two shillings out of a rival's book. I am not against your air. I am against calling the chair free.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have played on a bare stage with less than a glass. The yard heard the scene. They did not send up a rope to help it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The yard would hear a barrel. You are saving the verse and spending the entrance I would have had.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not spending your entrance. I am saying the castle does not need a rope. On Monday the parts of the king were not cast. They are still not cast. A barrel does not cast them.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I proposed lowering you, and the poet has answered with a boy and two men. I know when a sentence has outvoted me.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Five pound would buy the beam, the chair and the man to hang it, if the lease were longer than a quarrel. It is not. So the five pound remains a sentence at this table.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the four shillings remains a glass. I would rather the glass. It comes down without a committee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: So would I. Nobody has to winch a glass back up before the next scene can start.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Keep your glass. When there is a paper with a part on it, bring me that. Do not bring me a rope and call it a kindness.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no such paper. I told you so on Monday. I am telling you so over pork.

speaker: hired_men
text: Three pounds ten, and seven pounds two shillings. I have no third sum. I am not here to price a barrel.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Plates. If the beam was the crust, the crust is gone, and the table is wanted for the next men.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The crust had a better career than most beams. I am done. The pork was honest.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Eat, and leave the chair on the other side of the river. It can jam there without our money in it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Agreed. No five pound. No barrel. No committee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The castle stays in the air. It costs nothing to strike. That is the end of it for today.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I shall walk out on my own feet, which is the entrance I can afford.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: The door is that way. The next table is waiting, and it did not ask for a throne.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: We are going. The chair stays where it was reported, and not at this table.
